messages:
carol_support: FYI customers A and B are hitting a 502/timeouts spike from eu-central starting ~09:10 UTC. Support ticket has a few reproductions, lots of auth retries and gateway errors. graphs: https://internal.redwood/obs/graphs/abc-502-eu-central :point_down:

ben_infra: saw alerts too, getting the same. Can you paste the customer repro and any request ids?

carol_support: Repro (customer):
```bash
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Sometimes returns 200, sometimes 502 with body: `{"error":"gateway error: upstream reset"}`. Customer provided request ids: req_eu_0921_1, req_eu_0921_2.

infra_oncall: pulling traces. Early look: gateway logs show a flurry of `upstream reset` and `connection reset by peer` from our proxy pool in eu-central-1a -> eu-central-1b paths. Also seeing increased retransmits between those AZs in the last 15m.

alice_eng: can you dump a quick mtr between nodes? suspecting provider path flaps.

ben_infra: pasted short mtr from gw-eu-c-1a to gw-eu-c-1b:
```
Start: 2026-03-17 09:15 UTC
HOST: gw-eu-c-1a
1. 10.12.0.1 0.1%
2. transit-isp-1 0.5%
3. transit-isp-2 1.8%  (rising during spike)
4. gw-eu-c-1b 2.9% packet loss
```
Packet loss and high RTT variance on hop 3 -> 4.

dino-bot: ALERT: gateway-502-spike-eu-central (severity: high) — paging #incidents and @infra_oncall.

support_lead: escalate — customer SLA risk. Carol, open a support escalation with the customer, tell them we see regional provider instability and we're routing around it. Offer to failover to eu-west if they want immediate relief.

carol_support: done, customer is ok with a temporary region failover. Sending them steps.

ben_infra: short-term mitigation options: 1) enable route-policy to avoid the eu-central AZ pair for hosted API traffic (config push), 2) shift some traffic to eu-west endpoints for the affected customers, 3) add temporary retry/backoff on gateway for auth token errors to reduce client noise. I'll prepare a config PR for (1).

alice_eng: opened ticket with transit provider, included MTR and tcpdump snippet of retransmits + timestamps. Provider acknowledges and is investigating BGP churn on their peering at the time window.

infra_oncall: rolling a routing change to avoid the problematic edge pair, will monitor. If successful we should see 502s drop in 5-10m.

carol_support: customer confirmed reduced 502s after the reroute, still monitoring for auth retries. I'll keep them posted and ask for any further repros.

support_lead: create incident page + postmortem template. assign to ben_infra for RCA (network path + provider comms) and alice_eng for mitigation timeline. We'll circle back to customer with root cause and long-term fix (prefer BGP peering changes or cross-az path hardening).

ben_infra: quick note — logs to save for RCA: gateway logs around req_eu_0921_1/2, tcpdump from gw-eu-c-1a, MTR output, provider ticket id PROV-7342.

carol_support: thx all. I'll keep the thread updated and add customer's ticket id to the incident page. :thumbsup:
